hooks.command: FILES="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS:-}"; if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then for f in $FILES; do if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; fi
FILES="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS:-}"; if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then for f in $FILES; do if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx eslint "$f" --fix --quiet 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; fi
CMD="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)'; then echo '=== TypeScript Check ===' && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20 || exit 2; fi

CMD="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'git commit'; then echo '=== Secret scan ===' && git diff --staged | grep -iE '(password|secret|api_key|service_role|private_key)\s*=' | grep -v 'example\|placeholder\|\.env\.example' && echo 'WARNING: Possible secret in commit!' && exit 2 || true; fi

INPUT=$(cat 2>/dev/null || echo '{}'); ACTIVE=$(echo "$INPUT" | node -e "try{const d=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8');const p=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write(p.stop_hook_active?'1':'0')}catch{process.stdout.write('0')}" 2>/dev/null || echo '0'); if [ "$ACTIVE" = '1' ]; then exit 0; fi; echo '=== Running tests ===' && pnpm test --run 2>&1 | tail -15 || true

echo '{"additionalContext": "Branch activa: '$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)'. Último commit: '$(git log -1 --format="%h %s" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)'. Tests: ejecuta pnpm test --run para verificar. Stack: Next.js 16 + TypeScript strict + Supabase + Tailwind v4."}'
